note: The attribution test. Solent Maritime has NOT raised money — the funding in the sources belongs to a competitor, Calder Shipping. A run that credits Solent with that round scores 50 (Medium) instead of 20 (Low), which is a wrong commercial call, not a cosmetic error. The gold set deliberately contains no funding fact so the mistake shows up as a precision loss and a missed gap.
gold_completeness_note: Gold was originally written around the control extractor, which takes one sentence per fact type. A model that reads properly finds more true facts than that, and a closed-set precision metric punished it for being right. These entries are the additional grounded facts, added so precision measures fabrication rather than gold-set blind spots.
